context._note: Staged context for the demo: who depends on this app, what it needs, and what a restart disrupts. Read by the Reasoning step (appv2.site_context).
context.role: NFV orchestrator: drives NETCONF configuration to the network elements at each site
used_by: service-order portal (northbound API): new orders queue during a restart, none are lost
assurance and closed-loop automation: automated corrective actions pause until it is back
inventory-service: topology sync pauses and catches up afterwards
depends_on: zookeeper ensemble (leader election): must have quorum before the restart
inventory-service (topology feed): must be healthy, or the orchestrator starts on stale topology
context.during_restart: NETCONF sessions to every managed network element drop and reconnect; northbound orders queue; closed-loop actions pause
